title: Building concepts / Basement and Level_01
summary: The selected Basement corridor and service counter lead into Stage 7 individual assets. Level_01 retains its current concept studies. [Stage 7 asset and material brief](BASEMENT_ASSETS_STAGE7.md).

items.title: Basement refinement / Compare the two views
items.alt: Before and after comparisons of the Basement corridor and service counter with additional pipes and floor repairs
items.body: Review the changes from the first pass. [Kit notes and native views](BUILDING_STRUCTURE_CONCEPTS_STAGE6.md) · [First-pass Basement and office comparisons](media/building-stage6/comparison.webp) · [Generation prompts](sources/building-concepts-stage6.json).

items.title: Basement · Service corridor
items.alt: Basement corridor with four steel pipes on one ceiling edge, two on the other and two flush cement floor repairs
items.body: Four steel runs on one side and two on the other frame the existing fluorescents. A broad dry repair in the foreground and a smaller one farther in break up the concrete slab. [First-pass concept](media/building-stage6/basement-primary-concept.png) · [Native Unreal capture](media/building-stage6/basement-corridor-native.webp) · [Kit notes](BUILDING_STRUCTURE_CONCEPTS_STAGE6.md). [Stage 7 individual concepts](BASEMENT_ASSETS_STAGE7.md).

items.title: Basement · Service counter
items.alt: Basement counter with a compact overhead steel pipe run, a light cement repair and the A Clean Start poster above the spear-tip gate
items.body: The shorter steel run stays above the counter opening. The floor has a small flush repair, and a single lightly weathered A Clean Start print sits on the solid wall above the gate. [First-pass concept](media/building-stage6/basement-secondary-concept.png) · [Native Unreal capture](media/building-stage6/basement-counter-native.webp) · [Kit notes](BUILDING_STRUCTURE_CONCEPTS_STAGE6.md). [Stage 7 individual concepts](BASEMENT_ASSETS_STAGE7.md).

items.title: Level_01 · Shared offices
items.alt: Warm walnut wall caps and dark skirting under a continuous mineral-fiber ceiling with flush vents.
items.body: Keep the visible room openings, carpet and ceiling rhythm. Review the shallow cap and base profiles, one high transfer grille and the flush access and return tiles. [Native Unreal capture](media/building-stage6/office-peek-native.webp) · [Kit and material notes](BUILDING_STRUCTURE_CONCEPTS_STAGE6.md).

items.title: Level_01 · Executive room
items.alt: Walnut wall bays with warm and muted olive acoustic inserts and two prismatic ceiling lights.
items.body: Use the same ceiling family, wall cap and base as the shared offices. The proposed woven wall inserts are flush between walnut stiles. [Native Unreal capture](media/building-stage6/office-executive-native.webp) · [Kit and material notes](BUILDING_STRUCTURE_CONCEPTS_STAGE6.md).
